purpose: Stack every process-access event whose target is LSASS by the accessing image; rare/unsigned images touching lsass.exe are the primary credential-dumping signal.
Surface rare access masks on LSASS (e.g. 0x1010 / 0x1410 / 0x143a / 0x1fffff) which indicate read-memory/handle-duplication instead of benign query access.

args.query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "10" AND TO_LOWER(win.TargetImage) LIKE "*lsass*" | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, win.SourceImage, win.TargetImage, win.GrantedAccess, win.CallTrace, _id, _index

purpose: Read the individual LSASS-access events (host, source image, granted access, call trace) for any suspicious entry returned by the aggregations.

args.query: event.code:1 AND (process.command_line:*comsvcs* OR process.command_line:*MiniDump* OR process.command_line:*procdump* OR process.command_line:*mimikatz* OR process.command_line:*sekurlsa*)

purpose: Detect credential-dumping tool execution (comsvcs.dll MiniDump, ProcDump, Mimikatz-style command lines) on the Windows hosts.

args.query: FROM logs-windows.powershell-default METADATA _id, _index | WHERE event.code == "4104" AND (TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*mimikatz*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*sekurlsa*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*minidump*" OR TO_LOWER(powershell.script_block_text) LIKE "*comsvcs*") | KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, win.ScriptBlockId, _id, _index

purpose: Find script blocks containing LSASS-dump primitives (Mimikatz/Sekurlsa/comsvcs MiniDump) executed through PowerShell.
Look for registry writes against the SAM hive (credential material stored in HKLM\SAM\SAM\Domains\Account).

args.query: event.code:1 AND (process.command_line:*reg save* OR process.command_line:*esentutl* OR process.command_line:*\\SAM\\* OR process.command_line:*SYSTEM*)

purpose: Detect hive-copying commands (reg save, esentutl) used to exfiltrate SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM for offline credential extraction.
Detect creation/copy of ntds.dit (domain credential database) on disk.

args.query: event.code:1 AND (process.command_line:*ntdsutil* OR process.command_line:*"ac i ntds"* OR process.command_line:*vssadmin*)

purpose: Detect NTDS extraction tooling (ntdsutil IFM / 'ac i ntds', shadow copy creation) on the Windows hosts.
Confirm NTDS/hive extraction via process-creation auditing (4688) independent of Sysmon coverage.
Verify whether Kerberos service-ticket requests (4769) are in the collected Security telemetry at all; if absent, document that Kerberoasting cannot be confirmed or refuted from this window.
On the (non-overlapping) network capture window, stack Kerberos tickets by cipher — RC4/rc4-hmac TGS requests in bulk are a Kerberoasting indicator.
Read failing/anomalous Kerberos exchanges (error codes, unsupported cipher) that accompany roasting or credential misuse.
